description: Script profile registry for OCR/HTR routing. Support is NOT declared here: this file only names the profiles, their scripts, and which engine route could serve them. Whether a profile is supported is computed at runtime (services/ocr/script_profiles.py): the square Hebrew profile is supported when the Tesseract route is provisioned; a historical profile is supported only when a measured evaluation record (artifacts/benchmarks/htr-eval-<profile>.json) references an existing Kraken checkpoint by hash. Editing this file can never make a profile supported.

profiles.name: Hebrew (square script)
profiles.note: The printed square script of the Biblical Hebrew and Biblical Aramaic profiles. Served by the Tesseract baseline; Biblical Aramaic in this script is recognised with the same heb traineddata and the language profile is recorded separately.

profiles.name: Paleo-Hebrew
profiles.note: Epigraphic script of early inscriptions. No verified checkpoint or labelled evaluation set is provisioned.

profiles.name: Imperial Aramaic
profiles.note: Official Aramaic script of the Achaemenid period (papyrus and parchment hands). No verified checkpoint or labelled evaluation set is provisioned.

profiles.name: Jewish Babylonian Aramaic (square/rabbinic hands)
profiles.note: Manuscript hands differ substantially from printed square script; the Tesseract printed-text route is not claimed for them. No verified checkpoint or labelled evaluation set is provisioned.

profiles.name: Classical Syriac (Estrangela)
profiles.note: A distinct script, not a substitute for Hebrew-script Aramaic and not substituted by it. No verified checkpoint or labelled evaluation set is provisioned.
